import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def read():
    return int(input())

def qp(x, p, mod):
    ret = 1
    while p:
        if p & 1:
            ret = ret * x % mod
        x = x * x % mod
        p >>= 1
    return ret

def inv(x, mod):
    return qp(x, mod - 2, mod)

def add(x, y, mod):
    x += y
    if x >= mod:
        x -= mod
    return x

def sub(x, y, mod):
    x -= y
    if x < 0:
        x += mod
    return x

def FWT(P, opt):

    length = 2
    while length <= N:
        half = length >> 1
        for i in range(0, N, length):
            for j in range(i, i + half):
                u = P[j]
                v = P[j + half]
                if opt == 1:
                    P[j] = add(u, v, mod)
                else:
                    P[j] = sub(u, v, mod)
        length <<= 1
